title: Plantworks job record (v1)
description: What the broker returns for a job (POST /plantworks/v1/jobs, GET /plantworks/v1/jobs/{jobId}, POST .../cancel). See fork/src/broker/README.md.

class.description: The resolved class: the envelope's class, or the team spec's defaultClass.

priority.description: The effective priority stored at submit: the class's priority plus the envelope's offset. claim-next takes the lowest first, and a worker sends it to the endpoint (PW-29). Additive and fork-defined, pending the HarnessHG ack, as for the D11 fields.

detail.description: The PW-09 transition detail for the current state, for example {"reason": "front-door"} when cancelled. {} for states without detail.

result.description: null until a worker reports a terminal result (PW-21).
